questions.question: How should OP-01 be closed? Today, RFC-0029 R2 allows a freeze only after a full /observe-review has re-run on the record as its last reopen left it. BK-505 is the open item that decides what a freeze needs beyond that.

options.label: Close-out rule (Recommended)
options.description: Decide BK-505 now and amend R2. Only findings that change what a caller observes block a freeze. Bookkeeping notes (lists, counts, Decided-by cells, reasons) go to the spec flow. A close-out writes O84 to O87 with my recommended answers, unasked, and routes O88 to O91. Freeze after a check of only the close-out's own decisions, then write the spec. Costs one RFC amendment.

options.label: Freeze now, all routed
options.description: The same R2 amendment, but O84 to O87 are routed to the spec flow undecided, and the spec decides them as it writes each clause. Fastest, but four behaviour questions are then answered in the spec without a recorded decision.

options.label: Keep the current process
options.description: Another reopen session for O84 to O91, then another full review. On the trend so far, expect about 8 more items each round, with no end in sight.
